narrative: Cabo Verde secured a historic qualification to the knockout stages of the World Cup 2026 with a hard-fought 0-0 draw against Saudi Arabia. This result, combined with Spain's victory over Uruguay, meant Saudi Arabia was eliminated from the tournament.
